reason: One targeted reference revision after two completed old-reference sources showed distributed broken glazing, canopy pieces and ground sheets. Preserve same two-storey Art Deco hotel; clarify continuous opaque masonry, closed amber glazed panels and connected canopy/roof.

visualReview.notes: Actually inspected old reference, both failed native/final comparisons and this new generated triptych. Two storeys, red brick, pale piers, stepped teal crown, central gold ornament, broad connected canopy and paired planters retained. Front has3 upper windows and entry+2 ground windows; side has1 window per floor; back has2 upper windows and service door+2 lower windows with one attached fire escape. Windows are closed amber panels with painted curtains/interior hints, not depicted transparent cut-throughs. Walls, parapet and canopy read as continuous solid surfaces. Consistent floor/roof heights and chimney corner, common baseline, no detached ground sheet. Reference-only approval; actual native generation and final review remain required.
